active_scope: One guest-house operation with three suites and an 80,000 EUR works-and-installation envelope

milestones.objective: three-suite scope and room-count compliance confirmed
legal and operating structure, lease principles and asset-allocation method selected
80k quotes allocated between property works, detachable assets and working capital
80k interest-free shareholder-current-account commitments allocated between the SCI and operating company
separate shareholder-current-account agreements, individual schedules and five-year cash plans approved
sellable three-suite offer, conditions and pre-launch communication ready
tools, contracts, staffing and procedures ready for testing
go or no-go after dry runs, real photography and cash review

critical_dependencies: three suites -> five rooms and no more than fifteen guests -> updated municipal declaration and insurance
80k itemized quotes -> property-incorporated versus detachable asset classification -> invoice owners and payers
50k baseline shareholder current accounts plus 30k Maisonnette advance -> separate entity agreements -> five-year principal targets
operating company -> lease with SCI -> accounting and contracts -> booking and payment
VAT qualification -> annual tax-inclusive versus accounting model -> pricing and cash forecast
weekly staffing roster -> 1 full-time equivalent Jules plus 1,175 paid support hours -> service continuity
provisional 65k SCI and 15k operating-company shareholder current accounts -> written agreements -> annual liquidity decision and possible catch-up
market-consistent 12k rent -> lease -> standalone solvency of both entities
hammam and Nordic bath scope -> safety and insurance -> guest access and slots
pantry and signature table -> recipes and measured labor -> hygiene, allergens, alcohol licensing and booking
real operating procedures -> dry runs -> opening decision
external_validation_required: guest-house status, five-room and fifteen-guest limits, and exact Maisonnette capacity
resident-host welcome, breakfast, household linen and regular-cleaning compliance across three suites
municipal declaration or registration, works, destination, sanitation, fire, accessibility and insurance
lease, market-consistent 12k rent and allocation of works and recurring costs
invoice and asset allocation between SCI and operating company
80k interest-free shareholder-current-account allocation, agreements and five-year repayment targets
eligibility of every contributor to hold a shareholder current account in the receiving entity
standalone annual liquidity of the SCI and operating company before each principal repayment
payroll, weekly rest and paid-support contracts
pool, hammam and Nordic bath obligations
general terms, consumer mediation and personal-data protection
economic_evidence_to_collect: itemized quotes reconciling to the 80k total envelope
invoice allocation by asset owner and beneficiary
restricted schedule of each associate contribution, receiving entity and outstanding principal
five-year cash schedule for the SCI and operating company, including deferred-target rules
Urssaf and payroll validation for full-time Jules
paid-support quote around 25 EUR per hour and roster for 1,175 hours
three timed dry stays across all three suites
breakfast, pantry and signature-table recipes and labor measurements
hammam and Nordic-bath energy, water, wood, consumables and opening-time measurements
proof for 150 nights and 210 EUR achieved average within the 180–220 EUR grid
downside test at 140 nights and 205 EUR
decision_gates: Do not allocate the 80k shareholder current accounts until the spend is classified by invoice and asset owner.
Do not make the 16k consolidated annual principal target unconditional if it would create a cash deficit in either entity.
Do not use consolidated cash to conceal the SCI's 1k annual shortfall under the provisional 65k/15k allocation.
Do not raise rent to 18k while it makes the operating company cash-negative.
Do not interpret the 140-night case as viable merely because consolidated cash is slightly positive.

contents: associate names and individual contribution amounts
signed agreements, approvals and personal account details
repayment history and outstanding principal by associate
confidential_shareholder_current_account.rule: Use these data only for authorized associates and professional review; publish only non-sensitive derived conclusions.
